findings.source: blog.simplypatrick.com Jetpack Compose rendering architecture (CanvasHolder excerpt from AndroidCanvas.android.kt; AndroidGraphicsContext.android.kt layer selection)
findings.what: TWO laws: (1) CanvasHolder zero-alloc law: CanvasHolder constructs AndroidCanvas ONCE in <init>; drawInto(targetCanvas, block) only swaps internalCanvas ref, runs block, restores -> if AndroidCanvas never constructed, CanvasHolder itself never initialized, i.e. drawInto path never entered. (2) Layer selection law: SDK>=29 -> GraphicsLayerV29 (public android.graphics.RenderNode); 23-28 -> GraphicsLayerV23 hidden stubs with try/catch(Throwable)->GraphicsViewLayer; else ViewLayer software. RenderNodeLayer (1.6.x) = RenderNodeApi29 wrapper when SDK>=29
findings.relevance: engine reports SDK_INT=34 (dalvik_engine.cpp:22775) -> compose 1.6.7 RenderNodeLayer uses RenderNodeApi29 -> ALL draw traffic must go through android.view.RenderNode methods; the un-constructed AndroidCanvas means the chain breaks between beginRecording-return and DrawScope/AndroidCanvas wiring (CanvasHolder.drawInto or direct AndroidCanvas().setCanvas in RenderNodeLayer.record)
